ThingDef.label: atrium skylight (2x2)
ThingDef.description: A small domed glass atrium ceiling. It opens a two-by-two span of roof to the full sky — bright enough to grow crops by daylight, dark at night — and passes true sunlight for Biotech genes. Cast from structural glass panes set in a frame of structural supports. It won't work under thick overhead mountain.

ThingDef.label: tinted atrium skylight (2x2)
ThingDef.description: A small domed glass atrium ceiling in UV-filtering tinted glass. It opens a two-by-two span of roof to daylight — bright enough to grow crops, dark at night — but its tint keeps sun-reactive genes from triggering, so sun-sensitive colonists can stand beneath it unharmed. Cast from tinted structural glass panes set in a frame of structural supports. It won't work under thick overhead mountain.
